title: The influence of various rehydration protocols on biomechanical properties of different acellular tissue matrices
authors: Kasaj A, Levin L, Stratul SI, Götz H, Schlee M, Rütters CB, Konerding MA, Ackermann M, Willershausen B, Pabst AM. Clin Oral Investig. 2016 Jul;20(6):1303-15. doi: 10.1007/s00784-015- 1614-1.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Our findings demonstrated that the rehydration protocol affects the biomechanical properties of ACMs” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
